svg.aria-label: Phase portrait of the Vinograd–Hahn example. Every trajectory tends to the origin, but trajectories that start very close to it (inside the small dashed circle of radius 0.01) first make a large loop of size about 1. The origin is attractive but not stable, so it is not asymptotically stable
